URL: https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/irans-pezeshkian-says-country-in-full-scale-war-with-us/
NOTE: AFP via Times of Israel (newsroom, 20 Jul). Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian: "The reality is that today the Islamic Republic of Iran is engaged in a full-scale war," adding "we must be realistic and accept the natural consequences of this resistance" (presidency statement). Also: Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi told IRNA the war ends "either through absolute military victory or through negotiations. The right time to negotiate is precisely when you have achieved a reliable field and strategic achievement on the military front." FM spokesman Esmail Baghaei: "Tehran advances both war and diplomacy... The dichotomy of 'either war or diplomacy' is not acceptable."
